On 12 October 2026, the Global Coalition of Ukrainian Studies (GCU) Ukrainian Week was launched at Viadrina University. In addition to Viadrina’s accession to the GCU, the programme – which included lectures, a discussion, an exhibition and other events – provided insights into how Ukrainian studies at German universities can be strengthened in the long term and what is needed for even closer cooperation with Ukrainian universities.

The Erasmus+ KA107/171 programme enables the expansion of existing student and staff mobility to countries outside the European Union (so-called partner countries). The expansion of regular Erasmus+ mobility to these countries serves to deepen academic cooperation between Viadrina and its partner universities in Ukraine, Georgia and Kosovo.
